scope: Require the Publish 14.1 Novice Scout skill box as well as a positive trapping modifier for ordinary trap radial use, preventing passive Wookiee and Sullustan racial trapping bonuses from granting the Scout trap ability while preserving trap targeting, queuing, consumption, and experience behavior.

findings: The pinned Publish 14.1 implementation rejects trap use when trapping is below one or the player lacks outdoors_scout_novice.
The authenticated PRE-CU skill table grants both trapping and novice trap schematics from outdoors_scout_novice.
Wookiee and Sullustan passive species rows intentionally retain trapping bonuses, but those modifiers are bonuses to learned trapping rather than grants of the Novice Scout trap ability.
